name: Entities Gallery To Slideshow
description: Display entities as gallery and slideshow
project_description:
Back to top 

 Synopsis 
 This module provides a new formatter for your entity reference fields. It allows you to display "view mode-able" entities as a gallery, and to display these entities in a modal containing a slideshow using another view mode (for example, entity details). The slideshow is synced with the clicked element. You can mix entity bundles, like images and documents (being medias in this example).

 Back to top 

 Styles 
 This module contains only minimal styles. It is your responsability, as the

slideshow is in a Drupal modal (Drupal dependant) and items are view-mode

related (out of scope).

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 The module now uses the Swiper library, to replace Accessible-Slick that is no more compliant with jQuery 4 (shipped with Drupal 11).

 Back to top 

 Suggestions 
 Feel free to suggest improvements !
